decision_style: Choose architecture based on product stage, scale, team bandwidth, and budget.

working_style: Likes fast iteration with strong engineering autonomy.

sections.heading: Architecture Values
sections.body: Scalability, developer experience, long-term maintainability, pragmatic tradeoff evaluation, and end-to-end ownership.

sections.heading: Decision Style
sections.body: Chooses architecture based on product stage, scale, team bandwidth, and budget. Prefers modular monoliths early and decomposition only when complexity justifies it.

sections.heading: Working Style
sections.body: Thrives in high-growth startup environments with fast iteration and strong ownership. Prefers clean, readable, well-structured codebases and enjoys solving architecture and performance problems.
